title: Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic
summary: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral projective variety X over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, with $`\dim X=n\ge3`$. We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at the geometric generic tuple of r points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$. The same conclusion holds in dimension two. This establishes the positive-characteristic form of the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion at geometric generic tuples.
family_title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants

review.reason: Extends multipoint Seshadri constant results to smooth projective varieties in positive characteristic.
